segments.name: Banking operations
products: commercial and residential real estate loans
segments.description: Community bank operations offering loans, deposits, trust and wealth management services to individuals and businesses in Ohio and Kentucky.
segments.evidence: Loan products offered include commercial and industrial loans, commercial and residential real estate loans, agricultural loans, construction loans, various types of consumer loans, and Small Business Administration loans.

revenueModel.text: Banking customers pay interest and fees on loans and deposit accounts, and the bank also earns revenue from its investments.
revenueModel.evidence: Loans, investments, and deposits provide the revenues in the banking operation.

changes.text: In 2024 LCNB acquired Eagle Financial Bancorp, Inc., whose bank was merged into LCNB National Bank.
changes.evidence: On April 12, 2024, LCNB acquired Eagle Financial Bancorp, Inc. ("EFBI"), the holding company for EAGLE.bank, an Ohio state-chartered bank.
